versos.grego: Γνωρίζω δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, ὃ καὶ παρελάβετε, ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἑστήκατε,

controles.web: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
controles.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
controles.livre: Também irmãos, eu vos declaro o Evangelho, que já vos tenho anunciado, o qual também recebestes, no qual também estais.

versos.grego: δι’ οὗ καὶ σῴζεσθε, τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, εἰ κατέχετε, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ εἰκῇ ἐπιστεύσατε.

controles.web: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
controles.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
controles.livre: Pelo qual também sois salvos, se retiverdes a palavra naquela maneira, em que eu vos tenho anunciado; a não ser se tenhais crido em vão.

versos.grego: παρέδωκα γὰρ ὑμῖν ἐν πρώτοις, ὃ καὶ παρέλαβον, ὅτι Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν κατὰ τὰς γραφάς,

controles.web: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
controles.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
controles.livre: Porque primeiramente vos entreguei o que também recebi, que Cristo morreu por nossos pecados, segundo as Escrituras;

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτι ἐτάφη, καὶ ὅτι ἐγήγερται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ κατὰ τὰς γραφάς,

controles.web: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
controles.kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
controles.livre: E que foi sepultado, e que ressuscitou ao terceiro dia, segundo as Escrituras;

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτι ὤφθη Κηφᾷ, εἶτα τοῖς δώδεκα·

controles.web: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
controles.kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
controles.livre: E que foi visto por Cefas, depois pelos doze.

versos.grego: ἔπειτα ὤφθη ἐπάνω πεντακοσίοις ἀδελφοῖς ἐφάπαξ, ἐξ ὧν οἱ πλείονες μένουσιν ἕως ἄρτι, τινὲς δὲ ἐκοιμήθησαν·

controles.web: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
controles.kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
controles.livre: Depois foi visto de uma fez por mais de quinhentos irmãos, dos quais a maioria ainda vive, e também alguns já dormem.

versos.grego: ἔπειτα ὤφθη Ἰακώβῳ, εἶτα τοῖς ἀποστόλοις πᾶσιν·

controles.web: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
controles.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
controles.livre: Depois foi visto por Tiago; depois por todos os apóstolos.

versos.grego: ἔσχατον δὲ πάντων ὡσπερεὶ τῷ ἐκτρώματι ὤφθη κἀμοί.

controles.web: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
controles.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
controles.livre: E por último de todos também foi visto por mim, como que a um nascido fora do tempo.

versos.grego: Ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι ὁ ἐλάχιστος τῶν ἀποστόλων, ὃς οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς καλεῖσθαι ἀπόστολος, διότι ἐδίωξα τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ·

controles.web: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
controles.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
controles.livre: Porque eu sou o menor dos apóstolos, que não sou digno de ser chamado apóstolo, porque persegui a Igreja de Deus.

versos.grego: χάριτι δὲ Θεοῦ εἰμι ὅ εἰμι, καὶ ἡ χάρις αὐτοῦ ἡ εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ κενὴ ἐγενήθη, ἀλλὰ περισσότερον αὐτῶν πάντων ἐκοπίασα, οὐκ ἐγὼ δὲ ἀλλὰ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί.

controles.web: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was bestowed on me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
controles.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
controles.livre: Mas pela graça de Deus sou o que sou; e sua graça concedida a mim não foi vã; ao invés disso trabalhei muito mais que todos eles; porém não eu, mas a graça de Deus que está comigo.

versos.grego: εἴτε οὖν ἐγὼ εἴτε ἐκεῖνοι, οὕτως κηρύσσομεν καὶ οὕτως ἐπιστεύσατε.

controles.web: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
controles.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
controles.livre: Portanto, seja eu, sejam eles, assim pregamos, e assim crestes.

versos.grego: Εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς κηρύσσεται ὅτι ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγήγερται, πῶς λέγουσιν ἐν ὑμῖν τινες ὅτι ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔστιν;

controles.web: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
controles.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
controles.livre: E se é pregado que Cristo ressuscitou dos mortos, como dizem alguns dentre vós, que não há ressurreição dos mortos?

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔστιν, οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται·

controles.web: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
controles.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
controles.livre: E se não há ressurreição dos mortos, então Cristo não ressuscitou.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται, κενὸν ἄρα τὸ κήρυγμα ἡμῶν, κενὴ καὶ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν·

controles.web: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, and your faith also is in vain.
controles.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
controles.livre: E se Cristo não ressuscitou, então é vã nossa pregação, e vã também é vossa fé.

versos.grego: εὑρισκόμεθα δὲ καὶ ψευδομάρτυρες τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅτι ἐμαρτυρήσαμεν κατὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἤγειρεν τὸν Χριστόν, ὃν οὐκ ἤγειρεν εἴπερ ἄρα νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται.

controles.web: Yes, we are found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up, if it is so that the dead are not raised.
controles.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
controles.livre: E assim também somos encontrados como falsas testemunhas de Deus; pois testemunhamos de Deus, que ressuscitou a Cristo, ao qual porém não ressuscitou, se na verdade os mortos não ressuscitam.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται, οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται·

controles.web: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
controles.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
controles.livre: Porque se os mortos não ressuscitam, então Cristo também não ressuscitou.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται, ματαία ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, ἔτι ἐστὲ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.

controles.web: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
controles.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
controles.livre: E se Cristo não ressuscitou, vossa fé é vá, e ainda estais em vossos pecados.

versos.grego: ἄρα καὶ οἱ κοιμηθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ ἀπώλοντο.

controles.web: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
controles.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
controles.livre: Portanto também pereceram os que dormiram em Cristo.

versos.grego: εἰ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ ταύτῃ ἐν Χριστῷ ἠλπικότες ἐσμὲν μόνον, ἐλεεινότεροι πάντων ἀνθρώπων ἐσμέν.

controles.web: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
controles.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
controles.livre: Se nesta vida esperamos somente em Cristo, somos os mais miseráveis de todas as pessoas.

versos.grego: Νυνὶ δὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἀπαρχὴ τῶν κεκοιμημένων.

controles.web: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.
controles.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
controles.livre: Mas de fato Cristo ressuscitou dos mortos, e foi feito as primícias dos que dormiram.

versos.grego: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ δι’ ἀνθρώπου θάνατος, καὶ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν.

controles.web: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
controles.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
controles.livre: Pois dado que a morte veio por um homem, também por um homem veio a ressurreição dos mortos.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐν τῷ Ἀδὰμ πάντες ἀποθνήσκουσιν, οὕτως καὶ ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ πάντες ζωοποιηθήσονται.

controles.web: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
controles.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
controles.livre: Porque assim como em Adão todos morrem, assim também em Cristo todos serão vivificados.

versos.grego: Ἕκαστος δὲ ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ τάγματι· ἀπαρχὴ Χριστός, ἔπειτα οἱ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s, at his coming.
controles.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
controles.livre: Mas cada um em sua ordem; Cristo, as primícias; depois os que são de Cristo, em sua vinda.

versos.grego: εἶτα τὸ τέλος, ὅταν παραδιδοῖ τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρί, ὅταν καταργήσῃ πᾶσαν ἀρχὴν καὶ πᾶσαν ἐξουσίαν καὶ δύναμιν,

controles.web: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
controles.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
controles.livre: Depois será o fim, quando entregar o Reino de Deus e ao Pai, quando aniquilar todo domínio, e toda autoridade e poder.

versos.grego: δεῖ γὰρ αὐτὸν βασιλεύειν ἄχρι οὗ θῇ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
controles.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
controles.livre: Porque convém que ele reine, até que tenha posto todos os inimigos debaixo de seus pés.

versos.grego: ἔσχατος ἐχθρὸς καταργεῖται ὁ θάνατος·

controles.web: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
controles.kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
controles.livre: O último inimigo, que será aniquilado, é a morte.

versos.grego: πάντα γὰρ ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ. ὅταν δὲ εἴπῃ ὅτι πάντα ὑποτέτακται, δῆλον ὅτι ἐκτὸς τοῦ ὑποτάξαντος αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα.

controles.web: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
controles.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
controles.livre: Porque ele sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo de seus pés. Porém quando diz que todas as coisas lhe estão sujeitas, está claro que se excetua aquele que todas as coisas lhe sujeitou.

versos.grego: ὅταν δὲ ὑποταγῇ αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα, τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ Υἱὸς ὑποταγήσεται τῷ ὑποτάξαντι αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα, ἵνα ᾖ ὁ Θεὸς πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν.

controles.web: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
controles.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
controles.livre: E quando todas as coisas lhe forem sujeitas, então também o mesmo Filho se sujeitará a aquele, que todas as coisas lhe sujeitou, para que Deus seja tudo em todos.

versos.grego: Ἐπεὶ τί ποιήσουσιν οἱ βαπτιζόμενοι ὑπὲρ τῶν νεκρῶν; εἰ ὅλως νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται, τί καὶ βαπτίζονται ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν;

controles.web: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
controles.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
controles.livre: De outra maneira, que farão os que se batizam pelos mortos, se totalmente os mortos não ressuscitam? Por que, então, se batizam pelos mortos?

versos.grego: τί καὶ ἡμεῖς κινδυνεύομεν πᾶσαν ὥραν;

controles.web: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
controles.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
controles.livre: Por que também nós à toda hora estamos em perigo?

versos.grego: καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀποθνῄσκω, νὴ τὴν ὑμετέραν καύχησιν, ἀδελφοί, ἣν ἔχω ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.

controles.web: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
controles.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
controles.livre: A cada dia eu morro pelo orgulho que tenho por vós, em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.

versos.grego: εἰ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ἐθηριομάχησα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, τί μοι τὸ ὄφελος; εἰ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται, φάγωμεν καὶ πίωμεν, αὔριον γὰρ ἀποθνήσκομεν.

controles.web: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
controles.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
controles.livre: Se por motivo humano lutei contra feras em Éfeso, qual é o meu proveito? Se os mortos não ressuscitam, comamos e bebamos, que amanhã morreremos.

versos.grego: μὴ πλανᾶσθε· φθείρουσιν ἤθη χρηστὰ ὁμιλίαι κακαί.

controles.web: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
controles.kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
controles.livre: Não erreis. As más companhias corrompem os bons costumes.

versos.grego: ἐκνήψατε δικαίως καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε· ἀγνωσίαν γὰρ Θεοῦ τινες ἔχουσιν· πρὸς ἐντροπὴν ὑμῖν λαλῶ.

controles.web: Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
controles.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
controles.livre: Despertai para a justiça, e não pequeis; porque alguns ainda não têm o conhecimento de Deus. Eu digo isto para vossa vergonha.

versos.grego: Ἀλλὰ ἐρεῖ τις Πῶς ἐγείρονται οἱ νεκροί; ποίῳ δὲ σώματι ἔρχονται;

controles.web: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
controles.kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
controles.livre: Mas alguém dirá: Como ressuscitarão os mortos? E com que corpo virão?

versos.grego: ἄφρων, σὺ ὃ σπείρεις, οὐ ζωοποιεῖται ἐὰν μὴ ἀποθάνῃ·

controles.web: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
controles.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
controles.livre: Louco, o que tu semeias não é vivificado, se primeiro não morrer.

versos.grego: καὶ ὃ σπείρεις, οὐ τὸ σῶμα τὸ γενησόμενον σπείρεις, ἀλλὰ γυμνὸν κόκκον εἰ τύχοι σίτου ἤ τινος τῶν λοιπῶν·

controles.web: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
controles.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
controles.livre: E o que semeias, não semeias o corpo que irá brotar, mas o grão nu, como o de trigo, ou de qualquer outro grão .

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς δίδωσιν αὐτῷ σῶμα καθὼς ἠθέλησεν, καὶ ἑκάστῳ τῶν σπερμάτων ἴδιον σῶμα.

controles.web: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
controles.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
controles.livre: Mas Deus lhe dá o corpo como quer, e a cada semente seu próprio corpo.

versos.grego: οὐ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἡ αὐτὴ σάρξ, ἀλλὰ ἄλλη μὲν ἀνθρώπων, ἄλλη δὲ σὰρξ κτηνῶν, ἄλλη δὲ σὰρξ πτηνῶν, ἄλλη δὲ ἰχθύων.

controles.web: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
controles.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
controles.livre: Toda carne não é a mesma carne; mas uma é a carne humana, e outra a carne dos animais, e outra a dos peixes, e outra a das aves.

versos.grego: καὶ σώματα ἐπουράνια, καὶ σώματα ἐπίγεια· ἀλλὰ ἑτέρα μὲν ἡ τῶν ἐπουρανίων δόξα, ἑτέρα δὲ ἡ τῶν ἐπιγείων.

controles.web: There are also celestial bodies, and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
controles.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
controles.livre: E há corpos celestiais, e corpos terrestres; mas uma é a glória dos celestiais, e outra a dos terrestres.

versos.grego: ἄλλη δόξα ἡλίου, καὶ ἄλλη δόξα σελήνης, καὶ ἄλλη δόξα ἀστέρων· ἀστὴρ γὰρ ἀστέρος διαφέρει ἐν δόξῃ.

controles.web: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
controles.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
controles.livre: Outra é a glória do Sol, e outra a glória da Lua, e outra a glória das estrelas; porque uma estrela difere em glória de outra estrela.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ἡ ἀνάστασις τῶν νεκρῶν. σπείρεται ἐν φθορᾷ, ἐγείρεται ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ·

controles.web: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
controles.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
controles.livre: Assim também será a ressurreição dos mortos. Semeia-se o corpo em corrupção, ressuscitará em incorrupção.

versos.grego: σπείρεται ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ, ἐγείρεται ἐν δόξῃ· σπείρεται ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ, ἐγείρεται ἐν δυνάμει·

controles.web: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
controles.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
controles.livre: Semeia-se em desonra, ressuscitará em glória. Semeia-se em fraqueza, ressuscitará em força.

versos.grego: σπείρεται σῶμα ψυχικόν, ἐγείρεται σῶμα πνευματικόν. Εἰ ἔστιν σῶμα ψυχικόν, ἔστιν καὶ πνευματικόν.

controles.web: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
controles.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
controles.livre: Semeia-se corpo natural, ressuscitará corpo espiritual. Há corpo animal, e há corpo espiritual.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ γέγραπται Ἐγένετο ὁ πρῶτος ἄνθρωπος Ἀδὰμ εἰς ψυχὴν ζῶσαν· ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀδὰμ εἰς πνεῦμα ζωοποιοῦν.

controles.web: So also it is written, “The first man, Adam, became a living soul.”  The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
controles.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
controles.livre: Assim também está escrito: O primeiro homem, Adão, foi feito em alma vivente;O último Adão em espírito vivificante.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ οὐ πρῶτον τὸ πνευματικὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ ψυχικόν, ἔπειτα τὸ πνευματικόν.

controles.web: However that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
controles.kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
controles.livre: Mas não é primeiro o espiritual; mas sim o carnal, depois o espiritual.

versos.grego: ὁ πρῶτος ἄνθρωπος ἐκ γῆς χοϊκός, ὁ δεύτερος ἄνθρωπος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ.

controles.web: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
controles.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
controles.livre: O primeiro homem da terra é terrestre; o segundo homem, que é o Senhor, é do Céu.

versos.grego: οἷος ὁ χοϊκός, τοιοῦτοι καὶ οἱ χοϊκοί, καὶ οἷος ὁ ἐπουράνιος, τοιοῦτοι καὶ οἱ ἐπουράνιοι·

controles.web: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
controles.kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
controles.livre: Assim como é o terrestre, também são os terrestres; e assim como é o celestial, também são os celestiais.

versos.grego: καὶ καθὼς ἐφορέσαμεν τὴν εἰκόνα τοῦ χοϊκοῦ, φορέσωμεν καὶ τὴν εἰκόνα τοῦ ἐπουρανίου.

controles.web: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
controles.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
controles.livre: E assim como trouxemos a imagem do terrestre, assim também traremos a imagem do celestial.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο δέ φημι, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι σὰρξ καὶ αἷμα βασιλείαν Θεοῦ κληρονομῆσαι οὐ δύναται, οὐδὲ ἡ φθορὰ τὴν ἀφθαρσίαν κληρονομεῖ.

controles.web: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit the Kingdom of God; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
controles.kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
controles.livre: Porém isto digo, irmãos, que a carne e o sangue não podem herdar o Reino de Deus, nem a corrupção herda a incorrupção.

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ μυστήριον ὑμῖν λέγω· πάντες οὐ κοιμηθησόμεθα, πάντες δὲ ἀλλαγησόμεθα,

controles.web: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
controles.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
controles.livre: eis que eu vos digo um mistério: nem todos em verdade dormiremos; porém todos seremos transformados.

versos.grego: ἐν ἀτόμῳ, ἐν ῥιπῇ ὀφθαλμοῦ, ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ σάλπιγγι· σαλπίσει γάρ, καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐγερθήσονται ἄφθαρτοι, καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀλλαγησόμεθα.

controles.web: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
controles.kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
controles.livre: Em um momento, em um piscar de olhos, à ultima trombeta; porque a trombeta soará, e os mortos ressuscitarão incorruptíveis, e nós seremos transformados.

versos.grego: δεῖ γὰρ τὸ φθαρτὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσασθαι ἀφθαρσίαν καὶ τὸ θνητὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσασθαι ἀθανασίαν.

controles.web: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
controles.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
controles.livre: Porque é necessário que este corpo corruptível vista a incorrupção, e este corpo mortal vista a imortalidade.

versos.grego: ὅταν δὲ τὸ φθαρτὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσηται ἀφθαρσίαν καὶ τὸ θνητὸν τοῦτο ἐνδύσηται ἀθανασίαν, τότε γενήσεται ὁ λόγος ὁ γεγραμμένος Κατεπόθη ὁ θάνατος εἰς νῖκος.

controles.web: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
controles.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
controles.livre: E quando este corpo se vestir de incorrupção, e este corpo mortal se vestir de imortalidade, então se cumprirá a palavra que está escrita: Na vitória, a morte é tragada.

versos.grego: ποῦ σου, θάνατε, τὸ νῖκος; ποῦ σου, θάνατε, τὸ κέντρον;

controles.web: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
controles.kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
controles.livre: Onde está, ó morte, o teu aguilhão? Onde está, ó mundo dos mortos, a tua vitória?

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ κέντρον τοῦ θανάτου ἡ ἁμαρτία, ἡ δὲ δύναμις τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ νόμος·

controles.web: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
controles.kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
controles.livre: O aguilhão da morte é o pecado, e a força do pecado é a Lei.

versos.grego: τῷ δὲ Θεῷ χάρις τῷ διδόντι ἡμῖν τὸ νῖκος διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Mas graças a Deus, que nos dá vitória por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί, ἑδραῖοι γίνεσθε, ἀμετακίνητοι, περισσεύοντες ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ τοῦ Κυρίου πάντοτε, εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ κόπος ὑμῶν οὐκ ἔστιν κενὸς ἐν Κυρίῳ.

controles.web: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
controles.livre: Portanto, meus amados irmãos, sede firmes, imóveis e sempre abundantes na obra do Senhor, sabendo que o vosso trabalho não é vão no Senhor.
